Purpose: Establish the least disruptive local Kubernetes environment.
Expected Result: kubectl reaches the cluster and the node reports Ready.
Observed Result: Docker Desktop context connected successfully; the single control-plane node reported Ready on Kubernetes v1.32.2.

Purpose: Run one Aggregator and one API Pod against Docker-hosted Redpanda and PostgreSQL and verify the complete event/query flow.
Expected Result: Both Pods become Ready; health/readiness pass; an event reaches PostgreSQL and GraphQL; Kafka lag returns to zero.
Observed Result: Both Pods were Ready and healthy. Controlled event k8s-baseline-evt-001 produced one history row and correct current state, GraphQL matched PostgreSQL, and offsets reached 442/442 and 630/630 with zero lag.

Purpose: Scale to two Aggregator and two API replicas and measure actual Kafka assignment and Service routing.
Expected Result: Four Pods become Ready; the consumer group is stable; events remain correct without duplicates; API traffic reaches both replicas.
Observed Result: All four Pods were Ready. Kafka had two members with both partitions owned by one active member and one healthy idle member. Two controlled events produced two unique rows and version-2 current state; API requests reached both replicas.

Purpose: Delete the active Aggregator Pod during a controlled event stream and verify replacement, processing recovery, lag recovery, and data integrity.
Expected Result: Kubernetes replaces the Pod; processing resumes; no controlled events are missing or duplicated; current state is correct; lag returns to zero.
Observed Result: Replacement creation began immediately, rollout completed 14 seconds after deletion request, and its first observed projection occurred after 6 seconds. PostgreSQL retained 120 unique events and versions 1–120, current state reached version 120, and Kafka returned to zero lag.

Purpose: Delete one API Pod during repeated valid GraphQL requests and verify Kubernetes Service continuity and replacement routing.
Expected Result: Requests continue through the survivor; Kubernetes readies a replacement; later requests reach both survivor and replacement with no failures.
Observed Result: All 90 requests returned valid HTTP 200 GraphQL responses with zero failures. The survivor served 56 requests, the replacement served 22, and the deleted Pod served 12 before removal. Replacement Ready was recorded 37 seconds after deletion request.

Purpose: Confirm evidence completeness, clean manifests, healthy final runtime, and absence of temporary test resources or instrumentation.
Expected Result: Every reference exists; manifests validate and match live resources; health/readiness pass; lag is zero; no temporary triggers, hooks, Pods, Jobs, or CronJobs remain.
Observed Result: All 34 screenshot references existed; dry-run succeeded; live-manifest diff was empty; four intended Pods were healthy with zero restarts; Kafka lag was zero; PostgreSQL and runtime cleanup checks found no temporary failure objects or test workloads.
